I farm this small maize plot like my father did. I have no schooling, so I go by what I see working for my neighbors here in the north. Money is tight — I cannot afford a full bag of fertilizer for this size of land, so I put some goat and cow droppings from my compound on the plot before the rains. I save seed from last year's harvest because buying new seed every year costs too much, and I weed with my wife and my older brother when he has time. The rains here come once, so I just wait for them — no irrigation, I have no pump and no water near the plot.
